game.name: Pdc World Championship Darts (Europe)
game.desc: PDC World Championship Darts is a sports game on Xbox 360 that allows us to try our hand at darts. There are a dozen names known by the fans: Colin Lloyd, Mark Dubridge, John Part, Adrian Lewis... You can play against them in the five tournaments present: World Championship, World Grand Prix, Desert Classic, UK Open and Holland Open.
